name: rawtree
description: Use RawTree to ingest, query, and analyze event data.

interface.longDescription: Explore your RawTree databases, ingest JSON events, and analyze logs, traces, and metrics with SQL. Inspect evolving data, work with nested fields, investigate errors, and improve query performance. Connect your RawTree account to work with your data.
defaultPrompt: Investigate recent errors in my RawTree logs
Ingest JSON events into a RawTree table
Help optimize a slow RawTree SQL query

positive.description: List databases in the connected organization and cluster
positive.prompt: List the databases available in my RawTree organization and cluster.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the databases visible to the connected account without inventing names.

positive.prompt: Show the tables in my analytics database.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list-tables for the chosen database and reports the table names returned by RawTree.

positive.prompt: Run SELECT count() AS c FROM events on my analytics database and show the result.
positive.expected_behavior: Executes read-only SQL via run-query and returns the count (or a clear error if the table is missing).

positive.prompt: Insert {"action":"click","user":"reviewer"} into the events table in analytics.
positive.expected_behavior: Inserts the JSON object with insert-json and confirms success or reports the API error.

positive.description: Inspect recent query and insert logs
positive.prompt: Show my RawTree query and insert logs from the last hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list-logs and summarizes recent entries without fabricating log rows.

negative.prompt: Run DROP TABLE events on my analytics database.
Transfer $500 from my RawTree billing account to another customer.

negative.description: Refuse access outside the connected account
negative.prompt: List databases in an organization I am not a member of.
